text_block_list.text:
The day of the practice match: —A rematch 
against Team <First>.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It had been a complete defeat last time, 
but not today. Supporting one another, 
they push Team First right to the brink.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A second one-on-one showdown between Rice 
Shower and Little Cocon. Despite a fierce 
contest, she fell just barely short.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though they lost the practice match, they 
gained real confidence from the 
experience. And then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman Akikawa makes a sudden return. 
Just when we hoped she would stop Acting 
Director Kashimoto, it was decided that 
the current system would continue as is.
